name: io.github.fruggr/zendesk-mcp-server
title: Zendesk MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Zendesk Support & Help Center APIs — per-user OAuth 2.1 PKCE authentication, read-only mode, and token-efficient section-based article editing.

packageArguments.description: Your Zendesk subdomain (e.g. `acme` for acme.zendesk.com). May be supplied via ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN instead.

environmentVariables.name: ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Zendesk subdomain, if not passed as a positional argument.

environmentVariables.name: ZENDESK_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Agent email for API-token (Basic) auth. Set together with ZENDESK_API_TOKEN to bypass OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zendesk API token for API-token auth.
